verdict.rationale: The axis clearly applies to an ecommerce platform, but the evidence pack contains no documentation or community mentions of product variants, options, custom fields, or metafields — only generic references to REST/GraphQL APIs for 'managing products' and building headless storefronts. Missing for 10: any docs on variant/option modeling, custom fields, or metafield support, and any independent confirmation of catalog flexibility beyond a fixed template.
